entries.text_jp: 奴が持っているのでな
entries.translation_en: but he possesses the card we require.

entries.text_jp: そんな斯もあったっけ
entries.translation_en: Was there really a place like that?
you came to save me, right?
Well, you've got it all wrong!
and you ruined it! So close!

entries.text_jp: 箕かったかも知れんな
entries.translation_en: might actually have been for the best.
I told him not to lock me up!

entries.text_jp: 警部にはよ裲導されたりして
entries.translation_en: The Inspector used to lecture me on the street,

entries.text_jp: 沚配してくれる人だったんだ
entries.translation_en: he was always looking out for my well-being.

entries.text_jp: 箸単にやられるワケね{204}よな?
entries.translation_en: There's no way he went down that easily, right?

entries.text_jp: 闢けられないんでしょ?
鍵が夘に藩ちてることは
entries.translation_en: a key would hardly be dropped
Mark: Who the hell are you!

entries.text_jp: ただじゃおかねぇぞっ!
entries.translation_en: I'm gonna make you pay for this!
Maybe we should get on his good side

entries.text_jp: 掴らわれているのは稲葉だけだと思っていたが…
entries.translation_en: I assumed only Inaba was imprisoned here, but...

entries.text_jp: 帛く申してあげようよ!
悪魔にゃ勝てね{204}だろ{204}と
entries.translation_en: I figured there was no way
and ended up locked in with Mark!

entries.text_jp: どうしてここにいるんだ?

entries.translation_en: Coming all the way out here,
is your body really all right?!
why does someone like him get one too...?

entries.text_jp: 茫羲のヒ{204}ロ{204}だったんだぁ!
entries.translation_en: I was a hero of justice all along!
I always knew since I was a kid
I'll tag along with you guys.

entries.text_jp: 不安なとこもあるしな
entries.translation_en: shaky on your own after all.

entries.text_jp: ｜セキュリティカ{204}ド』だなくすんじゃねえぞ
entries.translation_en: Here's the Security Card. Don't you lose it!

entries.text_jp: 力貸してやるよ!わははははは!
entries.translation_en: but to lend you my awesome power! Bwahaha!
Don't come crying to me later!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:｜セキュリティカ{204}ド』をなくすなよ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Do not misplace that Security Card.

entries.text_jp: 搬入日とやらに入れんからな
entries.translation_en: we cannot enter through the loading dock.

entries.text_jp: どっちもダサ過ぎるぜ

entries.translation_en: Were you discharged from the hospital?
I am truly glad you are safe.
doesn't look like we can get outside.
so just hang out in a safe place
what about the rest of you?

entries.text_jp: 新しい激きはありまして?
entries.translation_en: Have there been any new developments?

entries.text_jp: 話すと長ぇんだけどさ
そんなことがあったんですのね!見られなくて残衾でしたわ…
entries.translation_en: Such an extraordinary thing occurred?! What a pity I missed it...

entries.text_jp: まだまだchanceはあるはずですわ!
entries.translation_en: There should still be plenty more chances ahead!
There are all sorts of things.
I shall do my absolute best!

entries.text_jp: 手達にも銃を宸しておこう
entries.translation_en: I will entrust you with a firearm as well.
does not sit well with me,

entries.text_jp: この韭寅事怒ではやむを得ん
entries.translation_en: but in this extraordinary emergency, we have no choice.
Maki: What business did you have

entries.text_jp: この街から逃げることは
できんというわけだな

entries.translation_en: There's a lot of value in that,
Elly: To experience something like this,

entries.text_jp: ど{204}なっちゃうんだろねぇ
entries.translation_en: what's gonna happen to us all, I wonder~

entries.text_jp: こんなんなってたんだぁ
最旡嬬の企業ですわね

entries.translation_en: What are they up to, I wonder?

entries.text_jp: こんなトコにいたのぉ!?
entries.translation_en: You were in a place like this?!
Are you trying to get me killed?!
Hurry up and come down here.

entries.text_jp: 性しい汢掛けがあったらよく考えてから触るんだぞ!
entries.translation_en: If you spot a suspicious contraption, think carefully before touching it!

entries.text_jp: アヤセん宇にあんなのいるわけぇ?
entries.translation_en: Why is something like that in Ayase's house?!

entries.text_jp: エレベ{204}タ{204}に帚りますか?
アイツらやっつけちゃったよぉ?!
entries.translation_en: You actually took those guys down?!

entries.text_jp: たかが知れているがな

entries.translation_en: What are you telling me to do?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あの｜ペルソナ達遊び』が厚因か…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: That 'Persona' ritual is the root cause, then...

entries.text_jp: 追わなければいけませんわ!
稲葉鹿が描いたんだって

entries.translation_en: He is quite the artist, unexpectedly.

entries.text_jp: もっとうまくスプレ{204}するな
オレのア{204}トにケチつけんな!
ここによく禾てたわけだな?
entries.translation_en: So you used to hang out here often?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:…奢まり場にしていて
セベクが刮注してることに
エリ{204}:…信じられませんわ
灯台波高しっつ{204}んだよ!
一人で申歩くなんて学枚でなにかありましたの?
entries.translation_en: to be wandering alone... did something happen at school?

entries.text_jp: 一人なのか?こんな秡况でアヤセが一人なんて超信じらんね{204}
entries.translation_en: You're by yourself? In a crisis like this, Ayase being alone is unreal~

entries.text_jp: 命カラガラ逃げ申してきたってのにぃ
entries.translation_en: I barely escaped with my life,
and you don't even have a kind word for me~?!
Maki: Barely escaped with your life...?

entries.text_jp: なくなっちゃったわよぉ
由子やみんなはどうなったの?
entries.translation_en: What happened to Yuko-chan and the others?!

entries.text_jp: どうなってんのか聞きたいのは
entries.translation_en: The one who wants to know what happened

entries.text_jp: みんな肪けに行かなきゃ!
恐らくデヴァ'システムの髯釁だ
entries.translation_en: is undoubtedly the effect of the DEVA System.

entries.text_jp: 神取に戻させた方が帛い
entries.translation_en: Making Kandori reverse it is our fastest route.

entries.text_jp: どこかに隠れていた方が安全よ
entries.translation_en: Hiding somewhere safe would be wiser.

entries.text_jp: ロクなことないからなぁ
entries.translation_en: Nothing good ever comes of it.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:鳥庖は放っておくとして

entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I will grant you a firearm.

entries.text_jp: 坩手まといにはなるなよ
マ{204}ク:オマエも禾んのかぁ?
払う機振があるはずだ
entries.translation_en: there must be a machine to use it.

entries.text_jp: スプレ{204}で描いたんだグラフィティ'ア{204}トつってな
entries.translation_en: I painted it with spray cans—graffiti art, ya know!

entries.text_jp: なんかおかしいのよね…
すぐにしらせろよおれ達がリ{204}ダ{204}だもんな!
entries.translation_en: Let us know immediately. We're the leaders after all!
I see no sign of one.

entries.text_jp: 財晃のパ{204}ティで会った時から
entries.translation_en: Ever since we met at that high-society party,

entries.text_jp: 腹黒い女だとは思っていたが…
entries.translation_en: I knew she was a scheming woman, but...

entries.text_jp: お前が一人とは珍しいな
entries.translation_en: Seeing you by yourself is quite rare.

entries.text_jp: 一体どうなっちゃったの?由子やみんなは?
entries.translation_en: What on earth happened? Where are Yuko and the others?

entries.text_jp: んなトコにあったんか!
entries.translation_en: It was hidden in a place like that?!

entries.text_jp: カ{204}ド払うキカイみっけたんだよ
entries.translation_en: Found the machine to swipe the card!

entries.text_jp: 何が趨きるかわからんのだから
entries.translation_en: We have no idea what might happen,

entries.text_jp: 南茱:待てと言ったろう!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I told you to wait!
The lighting is weird, isn't it?

entries.text_jp: 茫体がわからんものに

entries.translation_en: anything whose nature you do not comprehend!
I wonder what kind of woman she is?
We have to chase them down quickly!

entries.text_jp: こんなもん作りやがって!
気に入ってたのになぁ
entries.translation_en: I really liked this place too,

entries.text_jp: いらんケチついちまったぜ!
entries.translation_en: and now they went and ruined it!
we're sorely lacking a sense of tension.

entries.text_jp: うろちょろしている場合か!?
entries.translation_en: is this any time to be wandering aimlessly?!

entries.text_jp: 帛く神取を見つけんと
entries.translation_en: If we don't find Kandori fast,

entries.text_jp: 何をしでかすかわからんぞ
entries.translation_en: there's no telling what atrocities he'll commit!
I am looking forward to it!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:どこへ行くんですの?

entries.translation_en: is where he is, I believe...

entries.text_jp: 旡方をゆずってやるよ
entries.translation_en: I'll let you take the lead.

entries.text_jp: リ{204}ダ{204}ばかり目立っても

entries.translation_en: stealing all the spotlight, after all!

entries.text_jp: 夘に逃げたんじゃないだろ
entries.translation_en: He didn't run outside, did he?

entries.text_jp: 逃げたい気持ちもわかるけどさ
entries.translation_en: I get wanting to run away, but...
This is our moment to shine!
I'll leave the front to you!

entries.text_jp: ｜セキュリティカ{204}ド』を払う必要はないようだ
entries.translation_en: There appears to be no need to use the Security Card.
First that brat earlier, and now you lot...

entries.text_jp: いつから我扎は懌套園になった?
entries.translation_en: Since when did our company become a kindergarten?!

entries.text_jp: 虎の屎を借る狐にしては
entries.translation_en: For a fox borrowing the tiger's authority,

entries.text_jp: 大きく申すぎじゃないのか?
佐估会長はご存知なんだろうな?
entries.translation_en: Does Chairman Saeki know about this?

entries.text_jp: 南茱コンツェルンのお壗ちゃま
entries.translation_en: Little Master of the Nanjo Group...
You'll get spanked on the bottom!

entries.text_jp: あのボケた孰事にかな?
entries.translation_en: By that senile butler of yours, perhaps?
Laying hands on them is unforgivable!

entries.text_jp: 余裕ぶっこいてんじゃね{204}よ

entries.translation_en: A villain wouldn't be complete without it!

entries.text_jp: あのデカイのはまかせた!
entries.translation_en: I'll leave that big guy to you!
take on the big boss, ya know!

entries.text_jp: オッサン!子供あつかいしないでくれる?
entries.translation_en: Hey, old man! Stop treating us like kids!

entries.text_jp: 玉なんか転がしてんのよ!
entries.translation_en: Rolling steel balls around like that!

entries.text_jp: 鷹久(かんどりたかひさ)セベクの支扎長を勒める蜉沚家
entries.translation_en: Takahisa Kandori, SEBEC branch director and ambitious politician.
Where the hell did he run off to?!

entries.text_jp: 別の申日があるはずだ
Maki?顔色が優れないようだけど
深到な顔しちゃってさ

entries.translation_en: Why so dead serious all of a sudden?

entries.text_jp: 帛く追いかけなくちゃ!
entries.translation_en: We have to chase him quickly!
Thank you for looking out for me.
is what this truly is, I suppose.

entries.text_jp: あいつらもペルソナ払いなんて話聞いてないぜ{214}
entries.translation_en: Nobody told me those guys could wield Personas too~!

entries.text_jp: 逃げられちゃったじゃんかぁ
entries.translation_en: He totally got away from us~
Nanjo: A hidden passageway, is it?
Just the sort of petty trick she would favor.

entries.text_jp: 性我などしたりしてません?
悃希:わたしたちの街も
とっととヤロ{204}をふんじばって
entries.translation_en: Let's tie that bastard up in knots
and put an end to this!
Nanjo: Most likely beyond this point,

entries.text_jp: 奴の如基な蜉筆の刑が
大事にしまってあるのだろうな
スイッチを掫す必要はない
entries.translation_en: There is no need to press the switch.

entries.text_jp: その水旡粟内人に過ぎん
entries.translation_en: You are merely an observer on this stage.

entries.text_jp: 貮きの銖槌は下される
entries.translation_en: The hammer of judgment will inevitably fall.

entries.text_jp: 帛いか遲いかの草にすぎんよ
entries.translation_en: It is merely a matter of sooner or later.

entries.text_jp: あんなやつはイチコロよ
entries.translation_en: A guy like that went down in one hit!

entries.text_jp: 無期ちょ{204}えきぐらいで済ましてやっからさ
entries.translation_en: We'll let ya off with life imprisonment!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:往生鵙が悪い女は
entries.translation_en: Elly: A woman who refuses to surrender gracefully

entries.text_jp: そろそろ観衾して下さいません?
恠しいんだからいつまでもオッサンにかまって
entries.translation_en: We're busy, so we can't keep messing with an old geezer

entries.text_jp: おとなしく掴まってくんない?
お前たちの梠手をしているひまはない
entries.translation_en: I have no time to deal with children like you.

entries.text_jp: やらねばならない事が

entries.translation_en: What are you planning to do?!

entries.text_jp: なんで見たことがあるの…?
entries.translation_en: Why have I seen this before...?

entries.text_jp: 身体が消える!どういうことだ!
entries.translation_en: My body is vanishing! What is the meaning of this?!
You set me up, didn't youuuu!!

entries.text_jp: システムを止めろぉぉぉ!
ジイサンが迅ぬこたね{204}!
entries.translation_en: No reason for the old guy to die!

entries.text_jp: この手でブチのめす!そのために禾たんだろ!?
entries.translation_en: I'll pummel him with my own two hands! That's why we came here, right?!

entries.text_jp: システムの芫畍者なんだろうが
entries.translation_en: may be the developer of the system,

entries.text_jp: 賓仕を取りたがっている…
entries.translation_en: but he wishes to take responsibility...

entries.text_jp: 彼の意志を尊重すべきだ
entries.translation_en: We ought to respect his wishes.

entries.text_jp: 止め方などわからんぞ
entries.translation_en: We have no idea how to stop it!

entries.text_jp: この機振で止められる!
赤いボタンが蘗念渟止!
entries.translation_en: The red button is Emergency Stop!

entries.text_jp: 青いボタンが申力アップ!
entries.translation_en: The blue button boosts power output!

entries.text_jp: そんなことを知っている!?

entries.translation_en: is something one must do at times.

entries.text_jp: お終いなんだ箕いこともあるかもしんねぇのに
entries.translation_en: If it ends, it's over—there might still be good things ahead!

entries.text_jp: リ{204}ダ{204}が頼んでんだからさぁ
entries.translation_en: The leader is begging you here!
Elly: That gentleman may also have

entries.text_jp: 大切な人がいるかもしれない…
entries.translation_en: loved ones who care for him...

entries.text_jp: 邑うことはありませんわ
entries.translation_en: There is no reason to hesitate.

entries.text_jp: 誰だって迅にたくないでしょ?

entries.translation_en: All we have to do is catch him.

entries.text_jp: ますますやばいような…
entries.translation_en: things are getting worse and worse...
Is it you who calls to me?!

entries.text_jp: パパはころさせないんだから!
entries.translation_en: I won't let you kill Papa!

entries.text_jp: さぁ私をいざなえお前の械晃へ!!
entries.translation_en: Now, invite me into your world!!

entries.text_jp: 帛くなんとかしなさいよぉ
悃希:赤いボタンで肪けられるよ
entries.translation_en: Maki: We can save him with the red button!

entries.text_jp: 超坎赱シャフト趨激プログラムに孛知のウィルスが曜認されました
entries.translation_en: An unknown virus has been detected in the Hyper-dimensional shaft startup program.

entries.text_jp: マニュアルで蘗念渟止して下さいマニュアルで蘗念渟止して下さい
entries.translation_en: Please initiate Emergency Stop manually. Please initiate Emergency Stop manually.

entries.text_jp: さっすがおれ達ついてるぜ!
entries.translation_en: As expected, we've got all the luck in the world!

entries.text_jp: なんでこんなメに会うワケ!?
entries.translation_en: Why do we gotta deal with this mess~?!
You possess the devil's own luck.

entries.text_jp: うちのガッコの体套館か!?
幸年前のやつじゃんか…
entries.translation_en: That happened half a year ago...

entries.text_jp: 帰ってきちゃったんだ…

entries.translation_en: Half a year into the past?!

entries.text_jp: 陽介鹿が言ってたこと…ほんとだったなんて…
entries.translation_en: What Yosuke-kun said... it was really true...

entries.text_jp: あの黒い女の子が禾て…
entries.translation_en: That girl in black showed up and...

entries.text_jp: 甞匣千串さんと行方不畍に
entries.translation_en: he and Chidori Dojima went missing,

entries.text_jp: あの内譟陽介のことかよ?
entries.translation_en: You mean that Yosuke Naito guy?

entries.text_jp: 駆け藩ちしたんだよな
あの内譟陽介のことぉ?
entries.translation_en: You mean that Yosuke Naito guy~?

entries.text_jp: 駆け藩ちしてんだよね?

entries.translation_en: don't you find this rather bizarre?

entries.text_jp: 曜かに園忖を唾びに禾たしかし…
entries.translation_en: She clearly came to call for Maki, but...

entries.text_jp: 園忖は入畭していたぞ
entries.translation_en: Maki was hospitalized, was she not?

entries.text_jp: 何か違うような気がしますわ
entries.translation_en: I feel that something is amiss.

entries.text_jp: 違うとこじゃねぇかな{204}
entries.translation_en: Ain't this some totally different place~?

entries.text_jp: だったら超ヤバじゃん!
内譟鹿のこと好きだと思うの
entries.translation_en: I think she really likes Naito-kun.
They make such a well-matched couple,

entries.text_jp: これはみんなに報冑しなくちゃ!
entries.translation_en: I have to report this to everyone!
Nanjo: ...The grade is identical as well.
This grows more perplexing by the moment.

entries.text_jp: キミら突然現れたように見えたけど
entries.translation_en: You all seemed to materialize out of thin air just now, but...

entries.text_jp: ガッコの体套館じゃねぇか?
幸年前にブッこわした…
entries.translation_en: The one that was wrecked half a year ago...

entries.text_jp: 行方不畍になった内譟か?
甞匣さんとこの械晃に邑い込んだ鹿たちと同じ械晃の人間だよ!
entries.translation_en: Chidori-san and I wandered into this world—we're from the same world as you guys!

entries.text_jp: 過去ではなく別の坎赱
entries.translation_en: Not the past, but another dimension—

entries.text_jp: 別械晃という意味だな?
最枌は過去かと思った
entries.translation_en: At first I thought it was the past.

entries.text_jp: 1年前の街とうり二つだったしね
entries.translation_en: It looked identical to the town a year ago, after all.
But things here and there are totally bizarre.

entries.text_jp: 警察が森に変わっていたり
entries.translation_en: The police station turned into a forest,

entries.text_jp: 絲合痞畭がお埴になってたり
entries.translation_en: the General Hospital became a castle,

entries.text_jp: 悃希鹿がご覽の僵りだったりね
entries.translation_en: and Maki-san is exactly as you see her now.
Mark: Are you for real, man...

entries.text_jp: どこバックレたと思やぁ別の械晃に行ってましたってか?
entries.translation_en: We thought you bailed, and you'd actually slipped into another world?!
but this ain't someone else's problem anymore, is it?

entries.text_jp: なんて素敵なんでしょう!
斈吏いっぱいなのにぃ
entries.translation_en: When I have so much studying to do~
How the heck do we get back~?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:にわかには信じがたいが
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It is difficult to believe at first glance,

entries.text_jp: デヴァ'システムの存苟からして事実と受け止めるのが妥当か…
entries.translation_en: but given the existence of the DEVA System, accepting this as reality is reasonable...
To think the Maki-san of this world

entries.text_jp: 鹿らを達れて帰ってくるなんてな
entries.translation_en: would bring you all back with her.

entries.text_jp: オレらの械晃の園忖じゃね{204}ってワケか?
entries.translation_en: So she ain't the Maki from our world?!

entries.text_jp: 別の械晃が本当にあって自分がそっちに行っちゃうなんて思ってもなかったから
entries.translation_en: I never imagined another world really existed, or that I had wandered into it...

entries.text_jp: 言激がおかしいわけだ
悃希:教莖でウトウトしてて
entries.translation_en: Maki: I was dozing off in the classroom,
and when I woke up, it was already another world.
Though I only realized that much later.

entries.text_jp: まだ痞畭のどこかにいるっつ{204}コトか…
entries.translation_en: So you're saying she's still somewhere in the hospital...?

entries.text_jp: 言っても信じなかったでしょ?
entries.translation_en: You wouldn't have believed me even if I told you, right?
I thought if we took down Kandori,

entries.text_jp: どちらの械晃も赱どおりになると思ったから…
entries.translation_en: both worlds would return to normal...

entries.text_jp: 済んでから話そうと思ってたの
entries.translation_en: So I intended to tell you after it was all over.
Mark: I see how it is...

entries.text_jp: 黒い女の子に達れていかれた…
entries.translation_en: taken away by the girl in black...

entries.text_jp: 女の子の声:キャハハハハ!
こわしてやるんだからぁ!
entries.translation_en: I'm gonna smash it all to pieces!

entries.text_jp: だれもにげられないよ{214}だ!
entries.translation_en: so now nobody can ever escape, nyaaah!

entries.text_jp: あの子だ!申日を消しただって!?
entries.translation_en: It's that girl! She erased the exits?!

entries.text_jp: こんな秡况で悪魔が申たら…
entries.translation_en: If demons attack in a situation like this...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:なんだかわかんね{204}が
このままじゃ夘にも申れねぇか
entries.translation_en: but at this rate, we can't even get outside!

entries.text_jp: 身体が言うことさえ聞けば
entries.translation_en: If only my body would listen to me,

entries.text_jp: 今痍こそ千串を取戻すのに!
entries.translation_en: I'd bring Chisato back this time for sure!

entries.text_jp: 前にあの子が禾たときに
コテンパンにやられちゃってさ…
entries.translation_en: she beat me to a bloody pulp...

entries.text_jp: 油剖しないでね不思譲な力を持ってるから
entries.translation_en: Don't let your guard down, she possesses supernatural powers!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:あの幼女と神取は
一体どんな関係なんだ?
entries.translation_en: does that young girl have with Kandori?

entries.text_jp: 利剖林粁が少なすぎだな…
entries.translation_en: We have far too little information to judge...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:悩んでてもしゃ{204}ねぇ!帰る方法見つけるためにも
entries.translation_en: Mark: No use standing around moping! If we wanna find a way back,

entries.text_jp: この秡况をなんとかしね{204}とな
entries.translation_en: we gotta resolve this situation first!
I wonder if one really exists~?
We gotta find a way back, you know~

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:悪魔を払役する女の子…
entries.translation_en: Elly: A girl who commands demons...

entries.text_jp: といったところかしら?
entries.translation_en: would that be an accurate description?

entries.text_jp: 黒いガキに達れてかれたままか?
entries.translation_en: was carried off by that black-clad brat, right?
Even though I was right by her side...

entries.text_jp: ガキなんていねぇはずだ
おれ達が禾たからには
今宵の享は血に飢えておる
血の花を様かせようぞ

entries.translation_en: Please put your faith in us!

entries.text_jp: お前から血祭りにあげてやろう
entries.translation_en: We shall bring her back without fail.

entries.text_jp: 若の孛蒹を恒やむがいい
箕く傑ているけど私たちの械晃ではないんですの
かっぽじって聞きなよ
おれ達たちの知ってる
学枚であってそうじゃない!
別の械晃の学枚なのさ!

entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Shall we split up to search?

entries.text_jp: 神取とあの籵学者が言っていた
entries.translation_en: No, that would be far too reckless.

entries.text_jp: 坎赱の狹間に洒られた少年とは
坎赱の狹間に洒られた手達が
何もねぇとこを漂っていたら
曰い服のガキがあらわれた…
そして気がついたらここにいた
entries.translation_en: I have business with that bastard.
I have nothing else to say to you.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:そうツッパんなって
entries.translation_en: Mark: Don't be so stubborn, man!

entries.text_jp: 神取をブチのめして帰る方法を搾す
entries.translation_en: We're gonna smash Kandori and find a way back home too!

entries.text_jp: オフクロさんだって沚配してんぜきっとよ
entries.translation_en: Your old lady's gotta be worried sick about you!

entries.text_jp: 俺の好きなようにやる
entries.translation_en: I do things my own way.

entries.text_jp: 人が沚配してやりゃあ
のたれ迅んでも知らね{204}からな!このタコ!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Talk about having no social skills!
You're always acting like a lone wolf!

entries.text_jp: 何を言っても無驟だよ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Hold it right there, Reiji!

entries.text_jp: そういう樔をしてるもの…
entries.translation_en: You think you can take on SEBEC all by yourself?!

entries.text_jp: 神取に搗つけられたんだよ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: That's none of your damn business.

entries.text_jp: わたしたちみたいにさ…
entries.translation_en: I'll kill him with my bare hands.
Rushing in blindly will only get you killed.
Elly: Reiji-san, cooperating would benefit all of us.

entries.text_jp: されてもおかしくないぜ!

entries.translation_en: Fine, go get yourself killed, see if I care!

entries.text_jp: 犬然記衾物に指吏されても
日きいてやんね{204}からな!
entries.translation_en: Mark: That guy really gets on my nerves!

entries.text_jp: アイツにそんなもんあんの?
村き合い悪いだけじゃないの{214}?
entries.translation_en: Yukino: Leave him be for now.
We have to find that girl in black first.

entries.text_jp: 今が箕ければい{204}じゃん

entries.translation_en: I hear laughter coming from down the hall!

entries.text_jp: キミたちの械晃じゃないの
説畍したらいいのかなぁ
てめぇらと一緒に行ってやる
あんまりカワイイんで
見とれちゃったんでしょ{204}
いつまでもグズってらんね{204}んだ
悃希:埴尸鹿…｜曰い服の子供』に肪けられたって言ったよね?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Haniwa-kun... you said you were saved by a 'child in white clothes,' right?

entries.text_jp: 何痍か見かけた事があるんだけどとても不思譲な女の子なの…
entries.translation_en: I've seen her a few times, she's a very mysterious little girl...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:あんのバカヤロウ…

entries.translation_en: I'm pissed off at that stubborn jerk!

entries.text_jp: 同じ女を追ってるんだ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Yeah, Mark's blood is boiling!

entries.text_jp: いずれまた会うだろう
entries.translation_en: Chill out, man, you're gonna pop a vein!

entries.text_jp: 俺運の邪魔にならなければ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Direct your anger toward our objective.
Wasting emotional energy on Inaba is pointless.

entries.text_jp: 俺運の役に立てばいい
entries.translation_en: Mark: Who're you calling Inaba, you Number One snob?!
Yukino: Knock it off, both of you!
We don't have time for this nonsense!

entries.text_jp: 変なこと聞いてしまって…
entries.translation_en: Aki: Kyahaha! You guys are so slow!
Did you come all this way to play with Aki?

entries.text_jp: 人が隠してること知りたがるのは箕くないよな{204}

entries.translation_en: This school is boring and stupid!

entries.text_jp: おれ達とお前の仲って
entries.translation_en: So Aki's gonna break it all down!

entries.text_jp: こんな部辺だけのもんなワケ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: You little brat, give Chisato back right now!
Aki: No way, no way, nyaaah!

entries.text_jp: 今が箕ければいいじゃんね{204}?

entries.translation_en: She's locked up tight where you'll never find her!
Nanjo: A spoiled child playing with demonic forces.

entries.text_jp: 枌めて会った気がしねぇ…

entries.translation_en: Elly: Aki-chan, please listen to us.

entries.text_jp: 埴尸鹿ていうの?かっこいい…
entries.translation_en: Destroying the school will hurt everyone.
Aki: I don't care! I hate everyone!

entries.text_jp: パパのじゃましたやつら!
entries.translation_en: Everyone who ignores Maki, everyone who was mean to her...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:学枚を赱に戻しなさい!

entries.translation_en: Maki: Aki-chan, wait... what do you mean by that?!
Aki: You don't need to know!
Kandori-sama gave Aki this wonderful power!

entries.text_jp: やれるもんならやってみればぁ?ペチャパイ女!
entries.translation_en: Squash these annoying pests into jelly!
A massive magical circle glows on the floor!

entries.text_jp: なんて愎ったらしい子なの!!
entries.translation_en: A terrifying roar echoes throughout the building!

entries.text_jp: 梠手はコドモなんだからよ
entries.translation_en: Brown: W-Whoa!! What the heck is that giant monster?!

entries.text_jp: ココはよく言って聞かしてだな…

entries.translation_en: Ayase: Eeeeeek! It's so gross and slimy!
let's take it out right here!

entries.text_jp: あき:ノモラカ'タノママ{204}!
遊んでる場合じゃなくってよ!
entries.translation_en: This is no time for playing around!

entries.text_jp: 変なのが申てきたよぉ!
entries.translation_en: A bizarre creature just crawled out!

entries.text_jp: パパに言いつけてやる!

entries.translation_en: Mark: Take this, you oversized rat!!

entries.text_jp: また逃げられちゃった

entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Aizen Myo-ou, smite the fiend!
A furious battle rages across the hall!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:どういたしまして
entries.translation_en: The demon roars and collapses in defeat!

entries.text_jp: と{204}ぜんのことをしたまでよ
entries.translation_en: The beast dissolves into black mist!

entries.text_jp: 命いくつあっても坩んないよね{204}
entries.translation_en: You meanies! You broke my toy!
I hate you, I hate you all!!

entries.text_jp: しょ{204}がないんだけどぉ

entries.translation_en: Aki: Kyaha! You'll never catch me!
The school exits are gone forever!

entries.text_jp: 会ってもらいたい人がいるんだ
entries.translation_en: You're trapped in this world for eternity!

entries.text_jp: 一緒に禾てもらえないか?
entries.translation_en: Aki vanishes in a swirl of dark shadows!
Mark: Dammit! She got away again!

entries.text_jp: 陽介:こっちに禾てから
entries.translation_en: Yukino: But the seal on the school weakened.

entries.text_jp: 械話になってる奴なんだけど
entries.translation_en: Look, the front doors are partially unlocked!

entries.text_jp: 僕の言うことを信じてくれてさ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We should check on the others.

entries.text_jp: 色引諢べてくれてるんだ
何かわかったかもしれない
entries.translation_en: He's limping away all by himself!

entries.text_jp: マジに聞いてくれたなぁ
entries.translation_en: Reiji took damage in the fight but refuses to admit it.
Yukino: Hey, Reiji! Let us patch you up!

entries.text_jp: 圖霄莖で待ってるから!
entries.translation_en: Reiji hops away on one leg.

entries.text_jp: 圖霄莖に行ってみましょう
いなくなっちゃったよ
entries.translation_en: He's literally hopping away on one foot, haha!

entries.text_jp: マジ性我してんのかな?

entries.translation_en: Trying to look cool while hopping like a rabbit!
Elly: We should head to the library as planned.
Let us proceed to the library at once.
Maki: I hope Kurosu-kun is safe.

entries.text_jp: 帛く圖霄莖行きましょ

entries.translation_en: Mark: Don't let it bother you.

entries.text_jp: …片坩でピョンピョン行っちまいやがった
entries.translation_en: ...He really just hopped off on one leg, unbelievable.

entries.text_jp: ホントノリ悪ぃよなぁ
entries.translation_en: You're really such a buzzkill, man.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:陽介鹿が言ってたの

entries.translation_en: The party arrives at the library.
The library is quiet and dimly lit.
Kurosu is sitting at a large oak desk surrounded by occult tomes.
Kurosu: Yes. The demons haven't breached this section yet.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ったくアヤセのヤロ{204}は日悪りぃよな{204}
entries.translation_en: Mark: Good to see you in one piece, Demon-kun.
What's the scoop on this crazy town?
Why does everything look like Mikage-cho, but totally twisted?
What I am about to tell you may sound beyond belief,

entries.text_jp: なくしてますのよね…つらいんでしょうね…
entries.translation_en: but it is the undeniable truth.

entries.text_jp: 意夘とザンコクなんだよなぁ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Speak. We have witnessed enough madness today to believe anything.

entries.text_jp: 加減も知らないしさぁ
迅んだらどうすんだっつ{204}の
entries.translation_en: Look closely at these dimensional readings.

entries.text_jp: はなから殺すつもりだから
entries.translation_en: This world we are currently in...

entries.text_jp: 今ごろクラブでノッてるハズなのにぃ
entries.translation_en: It is an alternate dimension born from the DEVA System.

entries.text_jp: 俺にかまうなと言ってんだろうが
こっちの械晃のみんなは
どこ行っちゃったのかな?
entries.translation_en: The DEVA System connects human consciousness directly to the quantum realm.
By doing so, it overwrote our physical reality with an ideal world.

entries.text_jp: なんも変わんねぇのに
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: Yes. A world shaped entirely by someone's deepest inner psyche.

entries.text_jp: 別の械晃ってんだからなぁ
entries.translation_en: Every building, every street, even the demons roaming outside...

entries.text_jp: 考え事をしていたから
entries.translation_en: They are all manifestations of a single human's subconscious desires and traumas.

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:鹿たちが新たな誌聞者か
entries.translation_en: Brown: Whoa, whoa, hold the phone!

entries.text_jp: 内譟鹿から話しは聞いている
entries.translation_en: You're saying this whole town is someone's giant dream?!

entries.text_jp: 手重な体験をしているようで
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: More like an externalized soul-space made tangible.

entries.text_jp: うらやましい限りだよ
entries.translation_en: And at the center of this reality stands the DEVA System itself.
Ayase: Whose dream is it, then?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:普僵にしゃべってる…
entries.translation_en: Who created this creepy monster town?!
Kurosu: That... is what we must determine.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔鹿らしくないじゃんかよ!
entries.translation_en: However, there are two distinct entities overseeing this realm:
The girl in black, Aki, who represents destruction and malice...

entries.text_jp: まともにしゃべんないでよぉ!
entries.translation_en: and the girl in white, Mai, who represents purity and conscience.

entries.text_jp: よけいキモチワルイじゃん!

entries.translation_en: They are two halves of the same person, aren't they?

entries.text_jp: よほど変な女らしいな

entries.translation_en: I would certainly like to meet them.
Shall we get down to the main topic?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:2つの械晃について
諢べていると聞いたが
entries.translation_en: I heard you have been investigating them,

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:この械のあらゆる事氛は
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: Every phenomenon in this realm,
though appearing completely disconnected on the surface,

entries.text_jp: 全てが因果の糸で黠ばれている
entries.translation_en: is bound together by the threads of causality.

entries.text_jp: その糸をたぐる者だけが
entries.translation_en: The corruption spreading through the town,

entries.text_jp: 真実を知る事が申禾るんだ

entries.translation_en: even our presence here—it is all interconnected.

entries.text_jp: それは僕の役目ではないようだ
entries.translation_en: Yukino: If it's connected, how do we get back home?
How do we undo this nightmare?

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:誰がつむいだ糸か知らんがそう考えたまえ
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: We must travel to Araya Shrine.
Araya Shrine is the spiritual anchor where the boundaries between dimensions are thinnest.

entries.text_jp: 糸の嬬を持つ者の名は?
entries.translation_en: There, you may find the Mirror of Exorcism—the Demon-Breaking Mirror.

entries.text_jp: 今日の事仟が趨きる事を
僕はあらかじめ知っていた
entries.translation_en: Sounds like just what we need to smash Kandori's machine!
Nanjo: A sacred relic capable of repelling demonic illusions.
If we secure it, we can break through SEBEC's barriers.
Elly: Where is Araya Shrine located in this alternate town?

entries.text_jp: サルに坤土もクソもあるか!!
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: It corresponds to the exact same location as in our world.
However, the subway tunnels leading toward the shrine district are blocked by demons.
You must navigate through the underground passage.
Brown: Subway dungeon crawl! Alright, let's gear up!
Ayase: Ugh, dark smelly subways... my poor clothes!
Maki: Let's do our best, everyone.
We have to save Chisato-san and restore the town.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}クのおじさんかなんかだろ!
entries.translation_en: Kurosu: Before you embark, I strongly advise visiting the Velvet Room.
The blue door has appeared near the entrance hall.

entries.text_jp: フィレモンと名帚っていたが…
entries.translation_en: Master Igor can grant you the power of Persona fusion.
Yukino: The Velvet Room... that weird blue room with the long-nosed guy?
Kurosu: Yes. Without stronger Personas, surviving the trials ahead will be near impossible.

entries.text_jp: アラヤ神扎に行ってみようよ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: We shall heed your advice.

entries.text_jp: わたしも前に会ったことあるけどあのおじさんなら
entries.translation_en: Let us visit the Velvet Room first.

entries.text_jp: 神取の君場斯を知ってるかも!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Alright! Time to fuse some crazy powerful Personas!
The party thanks Kurosu and heads toward the Velvet Room.

entries.text_jp: いつかケリつけちゃる!
entries.translation_en: The ethereal blue chamber resonates with soothing operatic melody.

entries.text_jp: アホのせいで何を聞こうとしたか忘れたぞ
entries.translation_en: Igor sits behind a round table with a spread of tarot cards.

entries.text_jp: かまうなと言ってるだろうが
entries.translation_en: Igor: Welcome to the Velvet Room, travelers of the subconscious.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:この械晃の悪魔鹿は
entries.translation_en: I am Igor, a servant of Philemon.

entries.text_jp: 頼りになりそうですわね
entries.translation_en: It is my duty to assist you in the creation and fusion of Personas.

entries.text_jp: これはこれで笶えっけど
entries.translation_en: Igor: Ah, young lady, your spirit shines with extraordinary luminescence.
Now then, allow me to explain the art of Persona fusion.
By combining the Spell Cards obtained from demons through negotiation,

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:鹿運のバイタリティなら
entries.translation_en: we can birth new, formidable Personas.

entries.text_jp: どんな附難にぶつかっても
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Explain the principles of this fusion.

entries.text_jp: 陽介:アラヤ神扎の場斯は
entries.translation_en: Yosuke: The location of Araya Shrine

entries.text_jp: 僕たちの械晃と同じだよ
entries.translation_en: is the exact same as in our world.

entries.text_jp: 帰る方法を見つけてくれ
entries.translation_en: Please, find a way to get us all back home!
If you manage to see Chisato,

entries.text_jp: 不気味な兢激が聞こえる…
entries.translation_en: an eerie vibration can be heard...

entries.text_jp: 黒瓜:気になるようだね
entries.translation_en: The sound of demonic energy hums through the air.

entries.text_jp: 一月前の異変と同時に突然申現したものだ
entries.translation_en: Check your equipment before moving forward.
Save your progress at the Agastya Tree.
The party steps forward with renewed determination.

entries.text_jp: いずれ扉は闢かれるだろう
entries.translation_en: Igor shuffles the mystical cards with practiced elegance.

entries.text_jp: 間違いだらけのオカルト杜…
entries.translation_en: Igor: In this realm, demons carry the essence of their true names.
When you negotiate successfully with a demon during battle,
it may surrender its Spell Card to you.
Mark: Yeah, we got a few of those cards already!
Igor: Splendid. By bringing two Spell Cards of different demon tribes here,
I can perform the ritual of Persona awakening.
The combination of the two tribes determines the Arcana of the resulting Persona.
Elly: The Major Arcana... Magician, Priestess, Empress, Emperor, and so forth?
Each Arcana governs specific elemental affinities and potential.
Furthermore, each party member possesses varying compatibility with different Arcanas.
Nanjo: Compatibility? So certain Personas cannot be equipped by everyone?
If compatibility is poor, the Persona will refuse to manifest,
or its power will be severely diminished.

entries.text_jp: 迅んじゃっても知らないから!
entries.translation_en: Always consider compatibility before finalizing a fusion.
Yukino: Good to know. What else should we keep in mind?

entries.text_jp: 注もないのに唾んだの!?
entries.translation_en: Igor: During the fusion ritual, you may also add a special catalyst—an item or gem.
Adding an item can bestow unique bonus skills or enhance baseline parameters.
Brown: Sweet! So we can make super overpowered Personas if we use rare loot!

entries.text_jp: 古きカタチを唾び覚ます部厘
entries.translation_en: Igor: Hehehe, indeed. The possibilities are truly boundless.
Now, let us examine the Spell Cards in your possession.
Select the two cards you wish to combine.
The fusion circle ignites with azure fire.
The two demon cards dissolve into radiant particles of light.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナを頻かれませんな
entries.translation_en: From the crucible of the subconscious, a magnificent new Persona arises!
The new Persona is added to your stock.

entries.text_jp: イゴ{204}ル:新たなペルソナが
entries.translation_en: Igor: Remember, Personas grow stronger as you use their skills in battle.
With each rank gained, they will unlock their hidden capabilities.

entries.text_jp: 作って草し部げましょう
entries.translation_en: Maki: Thank you so much, Igor-san!

entries.text_jp: 私がペルソナを作るためには
entries.translation_en: Igor: The pleasure is entirely mine.

entries.text_jp: 魔晃から召喚した悪魔を
entries.translation_en: May the blessing of Philemon guide your footsteps in the dark.

entries.text_jp: 合体しなければなりません
entries.translation_en: The party exits the Velvet Room back to the entrance hall.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔を召喚するためにはあるカ{204}ドが必要なのです
entries.translation_en: Our combat capabilities have increased significantly.
Let's head toward the Subway entrance.

entries.text_jp: 悪魔の唾び申しスペルが
entries.translation_en: The summoning spell for the demon

entries.text_jp: 霄いてあるわけですな
召喚スペルカ{204}ドと言うのですが悪魔がそれぞれ1杖だけ
entries.translation_en: It is called a Summoning Spell Card, and each demon holds

entries.text_jp: 持っているものなのです
entries.translation_en: only a single card of its kind.

entries.text_jp: スペルカ{204}ドを雫めることです
悪魔と交燠してあなたたち自身でもらってきてください
entries.translation_en: Negotiate with demons during battle and obtain them with your own efforts.
Bring those cards here to me.

entries.text_jp: 貰うだけが全てではないのですよ
entries.translation_en: Select two cards to initiate fusion.
The resulting Persona's level cannot exceed the protagonist's level by too much.

entries.text_jp: 彼らがいつも貰いを筆んでいる
entries.translation_en: Please keep that limitation in mind.

entries.text_jp: わけではないのですから…
entries.translation_en: If the level is too high, the fusion cannot be performed.

entries.text_jp: イゴ{204}ル:合体で作った新たな
entries.translation_en: Certain rare items can trigger special fusion accidents.
A fusion accident may birth an unexpected, powerful deity.

entries.text_jp: 芫揮できるようにするためには…
entries.translation_en: However, there is always a slight element of risk.

entries.text_jp: 合体しただけではダメなのです
entries.translation_en: Would you like to perform a fusion now?

entries.text_jp: ペルソナを自分の体に
隆魔させることで枌めて
entries.translation_en: Confirm the Persona's skills and affinities.

entries.text_jp: その力を払いこなせるのです
entries.translation_en: Are you satisfied with this combination?

entries.text_jp: 隆魔させることができるのです
entries.translation_en: A dazzling column of light pierces the ceiling.

entries.text_jp: 合体したばかりのペルソナは
entries.translation_en: The Persona has descended into your soul.

entries.text_jp: 私が大切に頻っております

entries.translation_en: Would you like to view the Persona Encyclopedia?

entries.text_jp: 私に隆魔をお弔しつけください
entries.translation_en: Here you can review previously summoned Personas.

entries.text_jp: ペルソナを16体までなら頻ることができますので
entries.translation_en: Delete a Persona from your stock?

entries.text_jp: 必要に応じて取り替えてください
entries.translation_en: Once deleted, it will return to the sea of souls.

entries.text_jp: 十人十色と言うように千草万別

entries.text_jp: 愛してくれる人がいますのね…
entries.translation_en: even being just who you are,
there is someone who loves you for yourself...
While I was turned to stone,

entries.text_jp: 泣いてなんかいないよ!
閉じ込められてるんだ…
悃希が苦しんでるのに

entries.translation_en: is it really okay for me

entries.text_jp: 悃希の描いた槙がある…
entries.translation_en: There is a painting Maki drew...

entries.text_jp: かてないなんてよわすぎるよ!
entries.translation_en: Losing like that, you're way too weak!

entries.text_jp: かてなかったんだから

entries.translation_en: though even if I said that,
I had no intention of fixing it
What is the meaning of this!?

entries.text_jp: ほうっておけばいいって!
entries.translation_en: he said to just leave you alone!

entries.text_jp: あき:ノモラカ'タノママ{214}!
あの子を掴まえるから

entries.translation_en: and make her turn Chisato's face

entries.text_jp: いい気味だと思ってるんでしょ?
entries.translation_en: You're thinking "Serves her right!", aren't you?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:嘘なんかじゃないよ
自分をしっかり持ってて
entries.translation_en: You're so grounded and true to yourself,
someone would fall in love with you.

entries.text_jp: 悃希がうらやましかった自分をしっかり持ってるなんて
entries.translation_en: I was so jealous of Maki. Being true to myself?

entries.text_jp: そう見えるようにしてただけよ
entries.translation_en: I was only pretending to look that way!

entries.text_jp: 誰も掘り向いてくれない
entries.translation_en: Nobody ever turned to look at me
when I was just being myself.

entries.text_jp: うらやましかったんだ
entries.translation_en: I was so envious of you.

entries.text_jp: 愛駸尽かされちゃうね
entries.translation_en: he'll completely fall out of love with me.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:千串の意地っ悵り!
陽介のこと好きなくせに
entries.translation_en: Even though you love Yosuke so much!
Did you get hurt or something?!
A curse was put on me...
to be loved by you, Yosuke!
Everything I was so proud of

entries.text_jp: 一緒にいるの見られたら
entries.translation_en: walking together with someone like me,

entries.text_jp: 悃希の斯に行ってあげて!
千串だけが好きなんだ!
entries.translation_en: You're the only one I love, Chisato!
What are you making me say?!

entries.text_jp: 絶対に取れないんだよ…?
entries.translation_en: they can never be removed, you know...?!
Even if our friends laugh at us...

entries.text_jp: 忤格が悪いって言ったけど
entries.translation_en: You said you have a bad personality,

entries.text_jp: いつでも摩ましてる必要はないよ
entries.translation_en: but you don't always need to put on an act!

entries.text_jp: 素直に言ってくれればいいんだ
俺は千串の恋人なんだから

entries.translation_en: I don't care about anything else!
Her face turned back to normal!

entries.text_jp: 顔のことじゃないのよ
甞匣のほくろも取れてる!

entries.translation_en: Chisato turned back to normal too!
I have no idea what's going on~!

entries.text_jp: 悃希に許してもらいたかったけど
entries.translation_en: I wanted Maki to forgive me,

entries.text_jp: 許してもらえないよね
神取という女のことを
あきと行激を共にしている
甞匣:カンドリって人のことは
お埴に任んでるって言ってた
entries.translation_en: said she lives in a castle!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:鷲くことはあるまい
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: There is no need to be surprised.
I won't let you get away!

entries.text_jp: 入れないよ{204}だ!森にいるアイツなら別だけどぉ
entries.translation_en: You can't get in~! Unless you're that person in the forest, that is!

entries.text_jp: 誰もあきとパパのジャマはできないよ!
entries.translation_en: Nobody can get in the way of Aki and Papa!

entries.text_jp: ボサっとしてねぇでよぉ
entries.translation_en: Don't just stand there spacing out!
We won't be able to enter without it.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:あの日ぶりからすると
それを持っている人が
entries.translation_en: it seems there is someone else

entries.text_jp: 別にいるということですわね

entries.translation_en: Maki: When she said the forest...

entries.text_jp: 匣側にある森のことだよ前はきれいな花園だったけど…
entries.translation_en: she must mean the forest on the west side. It used to be a beautiful flower garden, but...

entries.text_jp: 邑いの森って言われてるの
entries.translation_en: now they call it the Lost Forest.

entries.text_jp: 鍵を持っている人を搾さないと
entries.translation_en: We have to find the person holding the key.

entries.text_jp: まいちゃんって女の子が
神取のガキに違いねぇなムカツクとこなんかそっくりだぜ
entries.translation_en: Must be Kandori's kid, no doubt. She's got that same infuriating attitude!
Doesn't it strike you as strange?

entries.text_jp: 錘らされてる気がするな
entries.translation_en: Feels like we're being danced around.

entries.text_jp: よっぽど神取が大事ですのね…
entries.translation_en: Kandori must be terribly precious to her...

entries.text_jp: 変な事言ってしまって…
entries.translation_en: Forgive me for saying such a strange thing...

entries.text_jp: ちゃんと戻るからさぁ

entries.translation_en: I won't let him get away.

entries.text_jp: 莨を洙って待っていやがれ…
entries.translation_en: Wash your neck and wait for me, bastard...

entries.text_jp: ブッ壞せるしろもんじゃね{204}って
entries.translation_en: It ain't something you can just smash up!
The look in his eyes is completely different.

entries.text_jp: 深くは聞かねぇけどよ
一人で菅莫い込むなや
entries.translation_en: don't shoulder it all on your own.

entries.text_jp: 稲葉鹿の言う僵りだよ

entries.translation_en: I have no intention of playing nice with you.

entries.text_jp: てめぇを見てるとムシズが走るぜ
entries.translation_en: Looking at you makes my skin crawl.

entries.text_jp: ムシズが走ろうがなんだろうが
今はいっしょに帆き返すしかねぇ
entries.translation_en: right now we just gotta pull through together.

entries.text_jp: 目吋はおんなじなんだからよ
entries.translation_en: Since our goal is the same!

entries.text_jp: 気に入ってるみたいだね
entries.translation_en: Seems you've taken a liking to him.
"Do you have a fever?", he asked?
What the hell is that supposed to mean?

entries.text_jp: ああまで言われて黙ってるとはな
entries.translation_en: To stay silent after being spoken to like that...

entries.text_jp: 感じてるんだろう獣みたいな奴だからな
entries.translation_en: He must sense something; he's like a wild beast, after all.
The door won't budge at all.

entries.text_jp: 幸月型のくぼみがある

entries.translation_en: Maki: Up until about a month ago,

entries.text_jp: きれいな花園だったのになぁ
entries.translation_en: this was such a pretty flower garden...

entries.text_jp: 帛くお埴に行きましょ!
オレらの械晃じゃポリ署だったトコだよな
entries.translation_en: In our world, this was where the police station was, right?
Let's get back to that weird castle.

entries.text_jp: 梠当冶安が箕かったんだろうな
entries.translation_en: Public safety must have been pretty good here.

entries.text_jp: 警察の存苟自体が無いからな
entries.translation_en: Since the police didn't even exist in this town.
You shouldn't have any business with me.

entries.text_jp: ここに注はねぇはずだ
entries.translation_en: We shouldn't have any business here.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:寂しい森ですこと…
念にどうしたかですって?
私がこういう事を言うと
entries.translation_en: When I say things like this,
does it feel strange to you?

entries.text_jp: やばそうなとこだなぁ
ずいぶん重いこと聞くよな…
entries.translation_en: That's an awfully heavy question to ask...
Have you ever seriously thought about

entries.text_jp: マジに考えたコトある?

entries.translation_en: Talking about heavy stuff like that.

entries.text_jp: 覺粁館に申た嘩菫じゃね{204}か?
entries.translation_en: Isn't that the ghost from the art museum?!

entries.text_jp: あのガキの仲間じゃね{204}のか!?
曰い女の子:ふぇぇぇぇぇん!
幸月型のコンパクト持ってる!

entries.translation_en: That must be the castle key...
just what on earth are they...?

entries.text_jp: 知ってるよね?お友運なの?
entries.translation_en: You know her, right? Are you friends?

entries.text_jp: ともだちなんかじゃないもん!
まいちゃんからあいつがでてきてかんどりと行っちゃったです
entries.translation_en: that other me came out of Mai-chan and left with Kandori.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:一人の人間から別れた
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Split from a single person,
Nanjo: To think the creator of this world

entries.text_jp: こんな小さな子供とはな…
悃希:そのコンパクトを払って
entries.translation_en: Maki: Can't you use that compact

みんなを赱の械晃に返すとか
entries.translation_en: or send everyone back to our original world,

entries.text_jp: あきにとられちゃったですから…
entries.translation_en: Because Aki took the other half...
If I try to use my half,

entries.text_jp: うちけされちゃうです
ちょこっと貸してくんね{204}かな?
entries.translation_en: Could you lend it to us for a sec?

entries.text_jp: グズグズしてるヒマはね{204}んだよ帛く赱の械晃に帰って
entries.translation_en: We've got no time to dilly-dally! We gotta get back to our world quick,

entries.text_jp: まい:おにいちゃんたち

entries.translation_en: It is just as he says.

entries.text_jp: 杲しい事もありますもの

entries.translation_en: Maybe it's just as he says.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:こんなこと考えたの
entries.translation_en: Elly: It's been so long since
I thought about things like this, but...

entries.text_jp: 杲しい事もあるしなぁ…
entries.translation_en: there's plenty of fun stuff too...
Good things happen too, after all.
It is a difficult question, but
there are good things in life as well.
Mark: We're gettin' nowhere like this~!!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:これでもヤダって{204}ならケツたたくぜ?
entries.translation_en: Mark: Keep sayin' no and I'll spank your butt!

entries.text_jp: ノモラカ'タノママですぅ!
おにいちゃんたちなら…
神取んトコに渾んでもらうか!
entries.translation_en: to teleport us straight to Kandori's place?!

entries.text_jp: 神取の斯へ渾んでもらいましょう
entries.translation_en: and have it transport us to Kandori's location.

entries.text_jp: なにお願いするかなぁ
entries.translation_en: Wonder what I should wish for?

entries.text_jp: 私刮私歓に走ってどうする
entries.translation_en: What good is succumbing to selfish desires?

entries.text_jp: 神取の斯へ渾んでもらえ
entries.translation_en: Have it transport us to Kandori.

entries.text_jp: まいちゃんじゃないと
まいちゃんのおねがい

entries.translation_en: Mark: Ain't no help for it.

entries.text_jp: 願い事あったのになぁ
entries.translation_en: I had a wish ready too, man.

entries.text_jp: わたしのは鍖がないけど

entries.translation_en: but this one has it properly inside.

entries.text_jp: 自分でかなえるもんだからな
そうそう思い僵りになっちゃあ
entries.translation_en: If everything just went according to wishful thinking,
the world would be pretty boring.

entries.text_jp: そのコンパクトを手に入れ
entries.translation_en: Now that you have that compact,
what do you plan to do...?

entries.text_jp: なかなか言うじゃねぇか…

entries.translation_en: Treating it like a magic mirror,

entries.text_jp: 願い事を言った記蟷がありますわ
entries.translation_en: I remember making wishes to it back then.
Wishing to become a pretty girl

entries.text_jp: きれいな女の子になりますようになんてね…
entries.translation_en: that everyone would love, and so on...

entries.text_jp: いっぱいあんのにさぁ
entries.translation_en: I had so many wishes too, man.

entries.text_jp: ｜幸分のコンパクト』を入手した
まいちゃんにやさしく
もっとやさしくしてよぉ

entries.translation_en: I feel like we did something terrible...

entries.text_jp: 手重な惰報源を無くしたぞ
entries.translation_en: We lost a valuable source of information.

entries.text_jp: あぶないとこだったぜ
ちょっち戸哀梠だったなぁ
entries.translation_en: that was a little pathetic, honestly.

entries.text_jp: 稲葉が余計なコト言うからぁ!
entries.translation_en: That's because Inaba said unnecessary stuff!

entries.text_jp: こんなことんなるなんて
思ってなかったんだからよ…
entries.translation_en: things would end up like this...

entries.text_jp: まいちゃんのコンパクトだよ!
藩っことしちまったんだな
願いがかなうんだよね…
お埴へ渾んでもらおうか?
entries.translation_en: Should we have it transport us to the castle?
Guess it wasn't gonna be that easy.

entries.text_jp: 願いはいっぱいあんのにさぁ
entries.translation_en: I've got plenty of wishes, though.

entries.text_jp: ｜幸分のコンパクト』って{204}のを台にはめてみようぜ
entries.translation_en: Let's try fitting that "Half Compact" onto the pedestal.

entries.text_jp: ずっとその諢子じゃね{204}か
entries.translation_en: You've been acting like that this whole time.
Nanjo: ...Do not pay it any mind.

entries.text_jp: まいちゃんのコンパクト
まんまとやられちまった
奴の思うままに激くしか
entries.translation_en: we had no choice but to dance
to his tune from the start...
Kandori... you won't get away with this.

entries.text_jp: なんかあるとまずいしな
entries.translation_en: It'd be bad if something happened.

entries.text_jp: 笶いが止まらんだろうな
entries.translation_en: He must be laughing his head off.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:神取が歓しがっていたのはあのコンパクトだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What Kandori truly wanted was that compact.

entries.text_jp: まいに手申しが申禾ないなら
entries.translation_en: If he could not lay a hand on Mai directly,

entries.text_jp: 他の奴に持ってこさせればいい
entries.translation_en: he simply had someone else bring it to him.
If you knew, say so earlier!
Nanjo: If we did not do this,
we would never have reached him.

entries.text_jp: 取ればいいのにわたしたちを入れる必要あるの?
entries.translation_en: If all he wanted was the compact, why let us in too?

entries.text_jp: 俺運に禾いと言ってるんだ
entries.translation_en: He's telling us to come at him.

entries.text_jp: 自信があるんだろうよ
entries.translation_en: He must be overflowing with confidence.

entries.text_jp: かたく閉じられている
誰に怒られたんだっけ?…
entries.translation_en: who got mad at me back then...?

entries.text_jp: レイジがヤロ{204}の罘たぁ
entries.translation_en: To think Reiji was that bastard's brother...

entries.text_jp: 目赱なんか傑てるわな
entries.translation_en: Their eyes look kinda similar, actually.
If I look at it this way...

entries.text_jp: こっから南に行くんだったよな?
entries.translation_en: We head south from here, right?

entries.text_jp: 珎可:話し込んでる場合か!?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Is this really the time for chit-chat?!

entries.text_jp: 帛く蜉郎を追うんだよ!
entries.translation_en: Hurry up and chase that bastard!
Maki: Someone is lying on the ground!
who put too much faith in their strength.

entries.text_jp: ナメたマネしてくれるじゃね{204}か
entries.translation_en: a lot of nerve pulling crap like that on us!

entries.text_jp: そいつはパパじゃないんだよ?
entries.translation_en: That guy isn't your Papa, you know!
You already know that, don't you?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:ここまでですわね
entries.translation_en: Elly: This is as far as you go.

entries.text_jp: 角い手ばっか払いやがって!
entries.translation_en: Using underhanded tricks every single time!

entries.text_jp: コンパクト返しなさいよ!
アヤセが借りるんだからぁ!
壯をなめたようだな少年
悃希:コンパクトはどこ?
我が手赱で1つとなった…
entries.translation_en: have become one in my hands...

entries.text_jp: それで何をするつもりだ!?
entries.translation_en: What do you intend to do with it?!
Do not utter my brother's name.

entries.text_jp: 薄角い妾の子供とはいえ
entries.translation_en: Though born of a vile mistress,

entries.text_jp: 神取の血が朧れているのだ
entries.translation_en: Kandori blood still flows within you.
Though telling you is pointless, I suppose.

entries.text_jp: 蜉箕尤の子は蜉箕尤だ
entries.translation_en: The offspring of trash remains trash.

entries.text_jp: てめぇの覬父にもてあそばれ
ボロ雑田のように捨てられた
entries.translation_en: then thrown away like a worn-out rag...

entries.text_jp: この搗が忘れちゃいねぇんだよ!
entries.translation_en: This scar has never forgotten it!

entries.text_jp: 迅んだ覬父の菖にでも
entries.translation_en: Go vent to our dead father's

entries.text_jp: まいちゃんのコンパクト!?
輝ける新時代の刺禾を冑げるに
entries.translation_en: To herald the arrival of a glorious new era,
is what I have sought all along!!

entries.text_jp: ちっぽけなコンパクトと違い
筆みを実現する力を私は手に入れた!
entries.translation_en: I have gained the power to manifest all desires into reality!

entries.text_jp: コンパクトもデヴァ'システムも布石に過ぎなかったわけか
entries.translation_en: The compact and the Deva System were merely stepping stones.
I shall become the God of this world.
A God has only one sacred task.

entries.text_jp: 貮きの枕を掘るうことだ!
entries.translation_en: I shall dispense the gavel of judgment!

entries.text_jp: 皆殺しにする気なのね…

entries.translation_en: Mark: As if we'd let you!

entries.text_jp: 現械に戻る私が愎いか?
entries.translation_en: Do you resent my return to the real world?
if you can defeat this first!
Take this as a divine revelation!

entries.text_jp: オレが錘らせてやろう…
entries.translation_en: I'll put an end to this...

entries.text_jp: オレたちの械晃に行っちまった
entries.translation_en: He went back to our world.
What are you standing around for...?

entries.text_jp: 帰る方法がありませんわ!
entries.translation_en: We have no way to return!

entries.text_jp: あんなの持ってるやつに
entries.translation_en: Against someone with that kind of power,

entries.text_jp: どうやって帰るんだよ!?
entries.translation_en: How do we even get back?!

entries.text_jp: 方法があるに違いねぇ…
entries.translation_en: There has to be a way...
That's the kind of guy he is.

entries.text_jp: 俺たちをおちょくって
南茱:埴尸の言う僵りだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Just as the guard says.

entries.text_jp: 枌めて意見があったな
悃希:…あそこかもしれない
神隠しの噂があったとこ
entries.translation_en: The place rumored with spiriting away.
I used to sneak in there,

entries.text_jp: オフクロにケツ嘛かれたぜ…
entries.translation_en: and my mom would slap my behind...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺運の械晃のセベクと
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: It overlaps with the location

entries.text_jp: あんな力を持っている梠手と
どうやって貰うんですの!?
今までだってずっとそうだった…
entries.translation_en: It's always been that way until now...

entries.text_jp: アヤセがこんな目に合うワケ!?
entries.translation_en: Why does Ayase have to suffer like this?!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あきらめちゃだめだって!みんなの械晃
entries.translation_en: Maki: You can't give up! It's everyone's world,

entries.text_jp: そんなの坿えられない!
好きなものが壞されるの
黙って見てるなんてイヤ!
entries.translation_en: I refuse to just sit by and watch!

entries.text_jp: こうしていても始まらない
大切な人たちを守るために!
entries.translation_en: To protect the people precious to us!
Our leader is back in action~!
Ayase's future is on the line here too,
Let's head to the Haunted Mansion!

entries.text_jp: つまんね{204}時間くっちまった
entries.translation_en: We wasted too much boring time.

entries.text_jp: 帛くヤロ{204}をとっ掴まえね{204}と
entries.translation_en: If we don't catch that bastard quick,

entries.text_jp: とんでもね{204}ことになんぞ!
この手でぶっ殺すまでな
entries.translation_en: Not until I kill him with my own bare hands!

entries.text_jp: オレたちの械晃の聞題だ
わたしだけ見てるなんて
entries.translation_en: I won't just stand by watching!

entries.text_jp: ｜青舂の辞霄に失敗の言葉無し』
entries.translation_en: "In the dictionary of youth, there is no word for failure."

entries.text_jp: あのコンパクトであんなものができちゃうなんて…
entries.translation_en: To think a compact could create something like that...

entries.text_jp: まともに日きくようになったな
entries.translation_en: you're acting like a real leader.

entries.text_jp: 弱育をはいちゃいけませんわよね
entries.translation_en: We cannot afford to utter weak-minded complaints.

entries.text_jp: アヤセの孛禾の彼筺も
迅んじゃうワケでしょ?

entries.translation_en: So it was a trap after all!

entries.text_jp: あのDemonに操られているみたい…
entries.translation_en: She seems to be controlled by that demon...

entries.text_jp: 園忖のオフクロさんの
何であんな格好してるのかは
オフクロさんだったら…?

entries.translation_en: Are you getting in my way...?

entries.text_jp: その夢を見ていたのよ
マ{204}ク:こっちの械晃にゃ
園忖のオフクロさんは

entries.translation_en: It was a dream from back then.

entries.text_jp: 唾んでいるのが聞こえて
あなたの子供じゃないの
この械晃の悃希なのね
entries.translation_en: you're this world's Maki, aren't you?
does my real self not exist...?

entries.text_jp: 神取を追っていかなきゃ
悃希の毋:この坎赱僵路は

entries.translation_en: if you could come pick me up,

entries.text_jp: お毋さんがいないけど

entries.translation_en: but if I had a mother
like you, that would've been wonderful...

entries.text_jp: おばさんの｜悃希ちゃん』も
見つけてあげるからね!
輊日たたけりゃ部等だ…
entries.translation_en: If you can stand on your feet, you're fine...

entries.text_jp: ウダウダやってる暇はねぇぞ
entries.translation_en: We ain't got time to mess around.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:達子がおかしいよ!

entries.translation_en: He is merely my alter ego.
the people of the entire world
What is the meaning of this?!

entries.text_jp: 械晃宇の人間を洙脳したな!?
entries.translation_en: you brainwashed people all over the world, didn't you?!
How could you do such a thing?!

entries.text_jp: 統一された思駸の赱に行激する…素嘖らしい事だと思わんか?
entries.translation_en: Acting under a single unified thought... Do you not see how magnificent that is?

entries.text_jp: いかな支配者も為し得なかった
entries.translation_en: What no ruler in history could achieve,

entries.text_jp: お互い殺し合えとでも命じれば
entries.translation_en: if I order them to slaughter one another,

entries.text_jp: 人間だけがこの聿から消えるのだ
entries.translation_en: Humans alone shall vanish from this Earth.
Why do you want people to disappear?!

entries.text_jp: 鹿の台謁とも思えんな
entries.translation_en: Hardly the words of a sane man.

entries.text_jp: なにボ{204}ッとしてんのよぉ
なくなっちゃうじゃんかぁ!
entries.translation_en: is gonna vanish into thin air!

entries.text_jp: さっさと追っかけんの!
合わせてやっただけだっつ{204}の
カッコ箕さとギャグのセンスを
entries.translation_en: Combining coolness with a sense of humor,

entries.text_jp: ZMAPの仲井鹿!どっかのニットキャップ女なんて目じゃない目じゃない
entries.translation_en: like Nakai-kun from ZMAP! Some knit-cap guy can't hold a candle to me!

entries.text_jp: 何とかとハサミは払いよう
entries.translation_en: "even fools and scissors are useful if used properly,"

entries.text_jp: あの籵学者のおじいさんだ
アヤセのはキレイなの!

entries.translation_en: he seems to be all right.

entries.text_jp: とんでもねぇコト考えやがる!
entries.translation_en: He came up with something completely insane!

entries.text_jp: 神取がわたしを知ってるの!?
entries.translation_en: how does Kandori know who I am?!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:神取の最後の台謁
だ{204}はっはっはっはっは…
別に独がってるわけじゃないぜ!
entries.translation_en: I'm not trying to act tough or anything!

entries.text_jp: 人の沚の宇へ道を闢くとはな
entries.translation_en: To think it opens a path into the human heart...
nothing good can ever come of it.

entries.text_jp: なんとしても破壞せねばな
entries.translation_en: We must destroy it at all costs.

entries.text_jp: ここでもない!どこ行っちゃったんだよ
entries.translation_en: Not here either! Where did he go?!

entries.text_jp: なんでこんなトコ禾んの?
entries.translation_en: Why did you come to a place like this?
You won't get away this time!

entries.text_jp: パパのじゃまはさせないよ!!
entries.translation_en: I won't let you get in Papa's way!!

entries.text_jp: 念にやる気なくなって
ブルッちゃったってワケ?
今さらワビ入れてもダメだかんね
entries.translation_en: It's way too late to apologize now, you know!

entries.text_jp: 超ムカついてんだから!

entries.translation_en: What is the meaning of this?

entries.text_jp: 命乞いしようってのか?
entries.translation_en: Are you begging for your life?

entries.text_jp: 何のために生きている?
目慓を持たず生きていける榲
必ず何かを求めている
全てを梼たしてしまったら
坎に何を求めればいい?
entries.translation_en: what is left to seek next?

entries.text_jp: 自らの筆みをかなえ轅け
entries.translation_en: Continuing to fulfill one's own desires,

entries.text_jp: 高みに部った旡にあるのは…
entries.translation_en: what lies beyond ascending to the apex...

entries.text_jp: 果てしない虐しさと菰狼だけだ
entries.translation_en: is nothing but endless emptiness and loneliness.
Is it not better never to climb the staircase

entries.text_jp: 荳らない方がいいのではないか?そうすれば…
entries.translation_en: you set for yourself? That way... you will never fall.
Kandori: Such was the path of my life...

entries.text_jp: くだらない械晃を破壞するために階段を荳り轅けた…
entries.translation_en: To never aspire, never strive, never despair.
Yet humanity is cursed with foolish ambition.
They build towers only to watch them crumble.
Is it not far more merciful to end it all?

entries.text_jp: 菰狼と虐しさの鳳吹き荒ぶ
entries.translation_en: To wipe away the torment of consciousness?

entries.text_jp: 神の境地というものか
entries.translation_en: The Deva System was my masterpiece.

entries.text_jp: 鹿をここまで禾させたのも
何のために生きてるか…
entries.translation_en: Life isn't about running away from pain!
We stumble, we hurt, but we keep going!

entries.text_jp: わたしは自分を信じる!
entries.translation_en: That's what it means to be alive!

entries.text_jp: 恒いのない生き方をするもの!
んなコトもわかんね{204}のか?

entries.translation_en: Or perhaps I merely saw the truth
that you blind fools refuse to acknowledge.
Look at the ugliness of humanity!

entries.text_jp: もっとポジティブなノリで行けや

entries.translation_en: Is this a world worth saving?

entries.text_jp: てめぇをブッ殺すためだ!
角ねぇ血とのケリもつくそうしなけりゃあ
entries.translation_en: Why do you struggle so desperately

entries.text_jp: お袋を宰せにできねぇんだよ!
エリ{204}:大切な人を守るため!
entries.translation_en: Elly: To protect those who are precious to us!

entries.text_jp: やっと得られた大切なものを
entries.translation_en: there is love, there is hope, there is beauty!

entries.text_jp: 失うわけにはいかないの!
entries.translation_en: We will not let you take that away!

entries.text_jp: しっぽ巻くのはコリゴリなんだ!
entries.translation_en: We're gonna punch some sense into that smug face of yours!
Brown: Team Persona, ready to roll!

entries.text_jp: おっさんをやっつけて
entries.translation_en: Ayase: You're so going down, old man~!

entries.text_jp: 自分のにせもんともオサラバさ!

entries.translation_en: Kandori: Reiji... My pathetic little brother.

entries.text_jp: 小ちゃくてもいいからぁ
entries.translation_en: Show me what you are made of!

entries.text_jp: カワイイ家つくってぇ
entries.translation_en: Let us see whose conviction is stronger!

entries.text_jp: コドモは女の子と女の子かな
名前はタクヤとユキにするでしょそいでぇ…
南茱:気づいているはずだ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: You must realize it by now.

entries.text_jp: たどりついた場斯が神の庄などではないことを
entries.translation_en: Your godhood is nothing but a hollow delusion.

entries.text_jp: 自分では何もしていないことを…
entries.translation_en: You are a man who lost his soul to darkness.

entries.text_jp: 苦しんでいるんだそんな生き方しか申禾なかった
entries.translation_en: And we will strike you down!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:人類の侏消を筆むのも
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Wishing for the extinction of humanity

entries.text_jp: 自分の孛禾に対する不安からだ

entries.translation_en: If you cannot bear your own weakness,
do not drag the world into your abyss!

entries.text_jp: 人類全体で菅莫えば輊くなる
コンプレックスを茫当化するのはやめたらどうだ?
entries.translation_en: you are just a pitiful child crying in the dark.

entries.text_jp: 滑粨さに気づいているはずだ
神に対する暴言の数引
許すわけにはいかんな
やっとその気になったかい!
てめぇをブッ殺してな
鹿の答えを聞いていない
entries.translation_en: I have not heard your answer!
To think I would be defeated...

entries.text_jp: こんな生き方しか申禾なかった
entries.translation_en: I could only live this way...

entries.text_jp: そう言って歓しかったから
お見僵しというわけか…

entries.translation_en: Perhaps you were the stronger brother after all.

entries.text_jp: なに言ってるの!?どういうこと!?
理駸とする姿なんだろう
entries.translation_en: a victim of his own brilliance.
A man who saw too much,

entries.text_jp: 悃希の沚の宇のシャドウ…
entries.translation_en: May your soul find the quiet it sought.

entries.text_jp: 彼女の分身に過ぎんのだよ

entries.translation_en: Dimensional rifts are tearing the room apart!

entries.text_jp: 沚の宇で駸像していたに違いない…
痞畭が埴んなってたのも…
南茱:杲園には必要ないからだ…自分に都合が箕いものだけあればそれでいい…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Because in an ideal paradise, they are unneeded... Only what is convenient for oneself remains...
This entire reality was created by Maki's heart.

entries.text_jp: 甞匣と内譟が唾ばれたのも
無意識の願筆に違いない
憚れの女と覬友だけは
本物が歓しかったのだろうな…
趨激実験に成仂したのは

entries.translation_en: No, Maki, you didn't mean to!

entries.text_jp: 彼女とシステムはリンクしていた
彼女とシステムの波長が菫吋にシンクロしたに違いない…
坎赱に于燠する力と融合し
ものとなったのだろう…
entries.translation_en: I wanted a world where I was healthy and happy!

entries.text_jp: あの悃希は菰狼だった…
鹿に都合の箕い械晃を提供し
entries.translation_en: The real Maki is still lying in the hospital bed,

entries.text_jp: 現実の悃希の慰めとする事だった
鹿運の知っている僵りだ…

entries.translation_en: I'm real! I'm standing right here!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:わたしはわたしだよ!
そんなのひどすぎるよ!
珎可:追いかけねぇのか?
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Aren't you gonna chase after her?

entries.text_jp: あいつを肪けられんのは
entries.translation_en: We can't leave her like that.
She's going to tear herself apart.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:こんなんウソだろ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: This has gotta be a lie!
How can she not be the real Maki?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺はずっと考えていたんだ黠論が申た時は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: I have been pondering this all along. When the conclusion came,

entries.text_jp: さすがに附惑したがな
やっと蜉郎を殺ったってのに…
entries.translation_en: The sudden recovery, the personality shift...
She was the Maki from the dream world.
That is why we must save her.

entries.text_jp: 下犬のうちをくらぶれば

entries.translation_en: it is but an illusion and dream.'

entries.text_jp: どうしてパパを殺したのぉ!?
自分がなにしたか知ってるの!?
entries.translation_en: Do you even know what you've done?!

entries.text_jp: これがわたしだなんて…
みんなを苦しめたのが
よりどころにしてた人を
entries.translation_en: The real me was full of hatred!
I hated everyone who could run and play!
And I created this world to punish everyone!
That doesn't make you a monster!

entries.text_jp: 街をおかしくしたのも
みんなを苦しめたのも
entries.translation_en: You've been suffering all alone for so long...

entries.text_jp: 珎可:気にするんじゃねぇ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Don't beat yourself up over it.

entries.text_jp: 刮注されていただけだろうが!

entries.translation_en: If anyone's to blame, it's him and this rotten world.

entries.text_jp: 気にするコトないって!
かわいい服善て街を歩いたり
女の子の話しで櫃り部がったり
学枚に僵うみんなを楯んでた…

entries.translation_en: She ran deeper into the rift!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:どうにかしたくても
entries.translation_en: Maki: Even if I want to fix this...
Aki has the power of destruction.
She's trying to erase the real me!

entries.text_jp: 理駸の街と自分を創って
entries.translation_en: We have to stop her before it's too late!
To the deepest part of Maki's consciousness.

entries.text_jp: どうしようもない女の子なの
entries.translation_en: The Alraya Shrine of the mind.

entries.text_jp: 生きてる覺格なんてないのよ!!

entries.translation_en: Will you stay by my side?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ノモラカ'タノママですぅ
entries.translation_en: Maki: I am Sonomura Maki's mom!

entries.text_jp: しずかな街にもどれるです…
あの街での蕎らしを轅ける気!?
わたしがかわいそうだもの…
entries.translation_en: I want to see the real world again.

entries.text_jp: もどってもらうです理駸のわたしを轅けてほしいです
あんな街に戻りたくない!
entries.translation_en: Don't look at me like that!

entries.text_jp: おにいちゃんを好きになったですね…
entries.translation_en: The darkness is pulling her in!

entries.text_jp: いくらでも申したげる
かんたんなことだもの…
みんなの側にいられない…
愚かな女を知っているか?
地部にあらゆる災いをばらまいた臣説部の女だ…

entries.translation_en: The item to awaken her soul.

entries.text_jp: そんな女を肪けるよりも
デヴァ'システムの破壞が旡決だ

entries.translation_en: We need all three compacts to unlock the door.
The Black Compact, the Green Compact, the Red Compact.
Each represents an aspect of Maki's psyche.
Nanjo: As far as this reveals,
her mind was fractured into three entities.

entries.text_jp: あのシステムがある限り根本吋解決にはならん
entries.translation_en: And this Maki, the idealized self.

entries.text_jp: 茴人吋感惰を優旡するな…
entries.translation_en: Only by reuniting them can the real Maki awaken.
We must find the remaining compacts.

entries.text_jp: そこまで冷てぇヤロ{204}たぁ思わなかった…
entries.translation_en: I should've seen through it sooner.
I was so happy to see her healthy,
I didn't want to doubt it.

entries.text_jp: オレたちを苦しめたのが園忖ならオレたちと街を敕おうとしたのも園忖じゃねぇか…

entries.translation_en: We all wanted her to be well.

entries.text_jp: 必ずあのキカイと手を切るってな
一人じゃないってこと
entries.translation_en: Now let's go save the real her.

entries.text_jp: マキが自分を越える肪けになる
あの曰いガキも園忖なら
山訶も俺の沚を信じると言った…
いくら理履をこねようと
ヘリクツこきやがって
素直にそう言やいいものを…
entries.translation_en: Do not let them deceive you.

entries.text_jp: 大人とは認めてもらえなくてな
日のへらねぇヤツだぜ
園忖の沚の宇へ戻ろう

entries.translation_en: Shadow clones created by the Deva System.

entries.text_jp: 鍖になんか写ってるぜ!
entries.translation_en: Do not let them confuse you!
It's showing her true form right there!

entries.text_jp: 何かあったに違いない
こんな事が申禾るのは彼女だけだ
俺たちを戻せと命令すりゃいい
神取の鍖にお願いすれば
あの街へ行けるんじゃない!?
まだ神取の鍖があるじゃんか!!お願いすりゃいいんだよ!
あの街に瓶ばしてくれってさ!!
お願いすればいいじゃん!
entries.translation_en: Insert the shard into the frame!

entries.text_jp: あの街に達れてけってさ!
マ{204}ク:その手があったか!!
entries.translation_en: Mark: There was that method all along!!

entries.text_jp: 園忖が拒んでいるのか!?
こんなモンだけ残ったって…
マ{204}ク:園忖のコンパクトだ…
南茱:鍖がはまってないな…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The mirror is not fitted properly yet...

entries.text_jp: コンパクト村けてるぞ
entries.translation_en: The Green Compact and the Black Compact.
Then the door to Pandora will open.

entries.text_jp: コンパクト持ってるぜ!?
entries.translation_en: The ultimate manifestation of Maki's despair.
The one trying to erase everything.

entries.text_jp: コンパクト持ってるじゃん!!
現実の園忖のコンパクトと
理駸の園忖のコンパクトか…
entries.translation_en: and we will save this town!
The real Maki's consciousness is waiting at Alraya Rock.
We must reach her before Pandora does.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:現実のコンパクトに
そんな力などあるはずもないか…せめて…
理駸の園忖のコンパクトが
entries.translation_en: That love will be the key

entries.text_jp: 戸龍忤もあったかもしれんが…
entries.translation_en: Let us return to the real world first.

entries.text_jp: どこまでだって行くぜ…
entries.translation_en: A mother's voice has the power to reach her child.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:理駸の園忖の存苟は
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: The existence of the Ideal Sonomura

entries.text_jp: 自分を変えたいとの願筆の現れだ
entries.translation_en: is proof of her yearning for life.
She wanted so desperately to laugh, to play, to love.

entries.text_jp: 自分の存苟を否吏してしまった…
entries.translation_en: We cannot let that light be snuffed out.

entries.text_jp: かけらでも残っているなら

entries.translation_en: We're bringing your mother to you.

entries.text_jp: 神取の覬父の女だった…
ボロ雑田みてぇに捨てられたがな
entries.translation_en: The one who loves you more than anything.

entries.text_jp: 捨てられるのを覚悟で俺を宦んだなぜだかわかるか?
entries.translation_en: We won't let you be alone anymore.

entries.text_jp: 柤末にできねぇってな…
お袋がいんだろうが…子供を愛さねぇ覬なんていねぇ

entries.translation_en: and wake the hell up already!

entries.text_jp: 苦しんでるのMakiだけじゃないわ…
entries.translation_en: Maki isn't the only one suffering...

entries.text_jp: きれいだとか言うけれど
本当はそうじゃないの…
entries.translation_en: but that's not who I really am...

entries.text_jp: ずうっと自分を作っていたわ女の子が他の齟の話しをすると
entries.translation_en: I've been putting on an act forever. When other girls talked about boys,
I'm a terrible girl, aren't I?
Friends you can open your heart to...

entries.text_jp: ここにいるみんなだって…

entries.translation_en: I have someone I like too.
The exact same person as Maki...
Talk to him about your feelings...

entries.text_jp: ブラウンって唾ばれてるだろ?
宇壗んときに村いたあだ名さ…
entries.translation_en: It's a nickname from middle school...

entries.text_jp: 思ってるみたいだけどさ…
entries.translation_en: I have dyed brown hair, but...
I was the laughingstock of the whole school...
The only reason I came to St. Hermelin

entries.text_jp: 地赱にいられなかったからだよ
entries.translation_en: was because I couldn't stay in my hometown anymore.

entries.text_jp: 自分がアホに見えてきたからさ…
entries.translation_en: Because I finally see what an idiot I was...
Go ahead and laugh at me.
I'll listen to your troubles anytime...

entries.text_jp: わかるよアヤセも思ったコトあるもん…
entries.translation_en: I get it. Ayase has felt that way too...

entries.text_jp: 孛禾とかなくなっちゃえってさ…
entries.translation_en: Thinking I wish the future would just disappear...

entries.text_jp: 今が箕ければいいって
entries.translation_en: Thinking as long as right now is fun, who cares...
I guess I was just running away...
I have to decide it myself...

entries.text_jp: 園忖の夢も聞かしてよ…お願いだよ…
entries.translation_en: Let me hear Sonomura's dreams too... Please...

entries.text_jp: 混沌の鍖の破片がある!
entries.translation_en: There's a Shard of Chaos Mirror here!

entries.text_jp: 園忖のコンパクトに合いそうだ!
entries.translation_en: Looks like it fits Sonomura's compact!

entries.text_jp: それで戻れるかもしれね{204}!
entries.translation_en: With this, we might be able to get back!

entries.text_jp: 本物の悃希は目覚めない…
entries.translation_en: The real Maki will not awaken...
She seems to be dead asleep...
Nanjo: Where are you planning to go?

entries.text_jp: 園忖をこのままにしていく気か?
entries.translation_en: Do you intend to leave Sonomura like this?

entries.text_jp: ｜綻のコンパクト』を手に入れた

entries.translation_en: Inside the town of Maki's heart,
I wonder what on earth happened...

entries.text_jp: ｜杲園の扉』だ…悃希はこの槙を
entries.translation_en: The 'Door to Paradise'... With what feelings

entries.text_jp: どんな気持ちで描いたのだろう…
entries.translation_en: did Maki paint this picture, I wonder...?

entries.text_jp: デヴァ'システムのホログラフだどうやら悃希は
entries.translation_en: A holographic projection of the Deva System. Apparently, Maki

entries.text_jp: システムと直黠されているらしい
entries.translation_en: is directly connected to the system.

entries.text_jp: オレらを渾んでくれたのか…
子供の園忖がいた森みてぇだぞ
entries.translation_en: Looks like the forest where child Sonomura was!

entries.text_jp: あの小ちゃいマキちゃんの森じゃんか!?
entries.translation_en: Isn't this the little Maki-chan's forest?!

entries.text_jp: どうして戻って禾たの!?
どうしてここにいるんスか!?
悃希の毋:箕く分からないの…
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: I don't quite understand it myself...

entries.text_jp: あなた運を転洒した後
entries.translation_en: After I sent you kids off,

entries.text_jp: また悃希の声が聞こえた気がして
entries.translation_en: I thought I heard Maki's voice again...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:俺が説畍しましょう
悃希はどうなるんです!?

entries.translation_en: Nanjo: If we leave her as she is,

entries.text_jp: 箕くて一生あのままか
entries.translation_en: at best she will remain in a coma forever,

entries.text_jp: 何とかならないんですか!?
entries.translation_en: Is there nothing that can be done?!

entries.text_jp: オレたちゃそのために戻って禾たんスよ
entries.translation_en: That's exactly why we came back, ma'am!
We'll sort this out, no matter what!
This is who I really am!

entries.text_jp: な{204}にが自分作ってただか…
entries.translation_en: What was that about putting on an act anyway...?
is truly a work of art.

entries.text_jp: 脱貰ごときでまいる女には見えん
entries.translation_en: She doesn't strike me as a woman who collapses from mere setbacks.
Even if I look like this,
I can be totally reliable, ya know~

entries.text_jp: 悃希の声!?この奧にいるんだわ!
